FFmpeg 7.1.1 (LGPL 2.1 or later), linked statically into libsbdts, a shared library of its own: it can be rebuilt
and replaced, or relinked against another FFmpeg built the same way. Source: https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-7.1.1.tar.xz
SHA-256 733984395e0dbbe5c046abda2dc49a5544e7e0e1e2366bba849222ae9e3a03b1, unmodified. The converter's own source and the build recipe: tools/build-ffmpeg.sh, tools/dts/sbdts.c.

configure (the TV):
  --disable-autodetect --enable-zlib --disable-shared --enable-static --enable-pic --disable-programs --disable-doc --disable-debug   --disable-network --disable-avdevice --disable-avfilter --disable-swscale --disable-postproc --enable-avcodec --enable-avformat   --enable-avutil --enable-swresample --disable-iconv --disable-everything --enable-decoder=dca,truehd,mlp --enable-encoder=ac3 --enable-demuxer=matroska,mov --enable-muxer=mpegts,adts   --enable-parser=dca,h264,hevc,ac3,aac,mlp --enable-bsf=h264_mp4toannexb,hevc_mp4toannexb,dca_core
  --enable-cross-compile --arch=arm --target-os=linux (zig cc -target arm-linux-gnueabi.2.17 -mcpu=cortex_a9-neon -mfloat-abi=softfp), HAVE_SYSCTL 0
